# Ramification in the quadratic extension generated by the square root of two

↑ **Parent:** [Quadratic extensions of the 2-adic numbers](quadratic-extensions-of-the-2-adic-numbers.md)

In $L=\mathbb Q_2(\sqrt2)$, set $\pi=\sqrt2$ and normalize $v_L(\pi)=1$, so $v_L(2)=2$. The two terms of $a+b\pi$ have valuations of opposite parity, giving $\mathcal O_L=\mathbb Z_2\oplus\mathbb Z_2\pi$. The nonidentity automorphism sends $\pi$ to $-\pi$, and $v_L(-2\pi)=3$. The [lower ramification numbering](lower-ramification-numbering.md) therefore gives the displayed groups. The different exponent is three.
